# Vue.js Workspace Instructions

Use the Vue.js orchestrator and worker agents under `agents/` for multi-step Vue work. Preserve Vue 3 Composition API, `<script setup lang="ts">`, strict TypeScript, Vue Router, Pinia or the existing state solution, and the project's UI library.

For every request, classify the input and follow source analysis, UI layout generation, functional development, accessibility validation, test-case generation, automated unit/integration tests, and cross-browser/responsive testing. Apply WCAG 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2 by default with WCAG 2.2 Level AA as the primary target. Reuse the compatible test runner and document commands, results, coverage, evidence, and residual risk.
